title: window.postMessage protocol between loader.js (host page, shadow DOM) and panel.html (iframe)

aw:ctx.when: right after the iframe loads and on every open()

aw:close.when: panel hidden by host (Esc, launcher toggle, AvatarWidget.close())

aw:ready.when: call open + greeting playing; mode may still be puppet because the live renderer mounts in parallel

aw:mode.when: renderer changed after aw:ready (live finished mounting, or it fell back); additive, hosts may ignore

aw:lead.when: call ended; host may forward to CRM — transcript itself is not sent (not persisted)

security: loader validates event.origin === panel origin; panel validates event.origin === host origin received in aw:ctx. No wildcard targets in production.
